The attached D41P41A ROM image is a reference for DS pixel clusters and ash/basalt/lava colours ONLY, not its arena layout, central Pokemon or symbol. Landscape 4:3, 1200 by 896 pixels, elevated top-down PMD ground camera, NO sky or horizon. Ash midtones RGB 90 84 79, dark layered brown-charcoal basalt, vivid cellular red-orange lava with winding yellow fissures, orange midtones RGB 250 160 40. Fine stippled ash texture, NOT brick paving. Complete rock top-face-foot volumes on low lateral crags. Full-frame immersion, ground and lava continue off ALL corners, no isolated diorama or floating island. IMPORTANT FOR LATER ANIMATED JETS: leave generous exposed LAVA ALONG THE FAR LEFT AND FAR RIGHT edges, including both TOP corners, with pools about a sixth of the frame width, available for tall foreground and background jets. Do not draw the jets yet; they will be animated independently. A safe broad grey ash approach enters SOUTH CENTRE, with generous movement space in the middle. Keep the central passage unobstructed by rocks or lava. Avoid a giant circular elevated plateau or arena ring, except the last final-clearing brief. No chosen boss or central object. NO cave mouth, black hole, portal, arch, bridge, building, ruins, altar, stairs, symbols, machines, Groudon, Pokemon, characters, items, text, UI, green plants, snow, fog or sun beams. Crisp small irregular DS pixel clusters, not painted fantasy art or smooth polygons. A NEW LARGE FINAL VOLCANIC CLEARING. A generous irregular grey ash fighting space fills the centre and lower half, not a small pedestal or floating island. Wide arrival from SOUTH CENTRE. The NORTH is CLOSED by an uneven natural basalt ridge; no north exit, gap, staircase, cave or dark mouth. LEFT and RIGHT lava bands extend behind and around the lateral low ridges and continue to TOP corners for later tall foreground jets. Keep the entire centre EMPTY of any structure, boss or symbol; no chosen Pokemon. Terrain extends off bottom corners, not a symmetrical ring. Single full-frame map.
